column1: # Table 5 of Zhuo et al. 2026: investigation of the pyrazole hinge-binding motif.
# Everything else in the molecule is held constant: only the hinge binder changes.
# Compound 18 carries the 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine and is the comparator.
# The trade is stark: 22 is 44-fold weaker than 18 on the enzyme and nearly twice as
# selective, and it is the one that works in a dog.
